card.name: Start of a rate or frequency figure
card.fires_on: The space, "in", or decimal point right before a number that states how often something occurs, such as "1 in 14,000" or "1-2 per 1,000". It appears in incidence and prevalence statements.

modes.label: Incidence of a condition
modes.description: The point just before a number giving how common a disorder or reaction is.

modes.label: Decimal or dose figure
modes.description: A decimal point or space before a rate or per-weight value.

card.writes: It favors Chinese words meaning rate, ratio or proportion, so it points toward a statement of how often something occurs.
card.plain: It fires just before a number that says how common a condition or reaction is.
